The written questionnaire is live and working

Deployed 4 November 2026, 20:29 GMT; live verification completed at 20:29:40 GMT.

Open the corrected health questions →

What changed

The app previously blocked all questions when the external provider was unavailable. The existing written question set now opens inside the shared app frame, saves privately, resumes after closing and can be completed and edited. The current medicine catalogue is available only after the written questions are complete.

Clinical boundary

This is a saved written questionnaire, not a prescription, eligibility approval or a completed clinical assessment. Provider submission and secure pharmacy image upload still require the provider connection. Images are not uploaded or persisted by this questionnaire. Payment stays disabled. No live payment, real member, provider submission or message was used in verification.

Verified results

  • Production: 15/15 conditions in Chromium and 15/15 in WebKit.
  • Hosted test site: the same 30/30 questionnaire conditions.
  • 50/50 unit/model/database tests, including consent, account isolation, retry idempotency, stale devices, adult boundary and actual existing health erasure.
  • The three existing V7 journeys rerun: 52/52 conditions across Chromium and WebKit.

Browser profiles: 390 × 844, 2×, touch/mobile emulation on the Mac. These are not physical iPhone or Android recordings. The two live navigation recordings and raw results are retained with the release evidence.
